carriedFindings.P1: W02c and W02b-F: a gate-side drain must settle in every state once no consumed action lacks a terminal record (DRAINED, drainPending cleared, I07 answered), including INVALIDATED and after a refused seal; a WRITE_BEGIN arriving in INVALIDATED or DRAINING waits for the same fence or gets an answer W02c treats as no write; ARM outside ACTIVE after invalidation is refused NOT_ACTIVE
carriedFindings.P2: W02b-F: restrict a DELETE UID to this execution's own CREATE 201, or make manifest identity and digest resolve to at most one run across every run the gate has bound (durable, like priorBindings); until then Decision 10's cross-run cleanup claim relies on I02's one-case-per-digest and unique-name rules
carriedFindings.P3: W02b-F: the storage-failure path's denied actions are reported in deniedActionIds and in the EXPIRE and DRAIN outputs (T58 pins [] although the journal shows the deny)
carriedFindings.P4: W02b-F: a restart after a write failure that could not itself be recorded starts HELD (failure marker in a separate failure domain), or the residual against base section 5 is disclosed; the OK HELD answer to RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED is not durable in that case
carriedFindings.P5: W02b-F: the CREATE and DELETE 4xx agreement rows exclude 408; the DELETE 202 row is unreachable with the pinned DeleteOptions
carriedFindings.P6: W02b-F and W03: pin the upstream tag for the DELETE-body sources and re-check against the selected distribution; a deletion that is not immediate (finalizers) returns the object body and is held
carriedFindings.P7: W02b-F: decode_frame maps RecursionError to F06 or F01 and gives wrong-type input its own code
carriedFindings.P8: W02b-F: T74 and T81 intents claim cases the transcripts do not contain
